changes: First release, for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74: MrScruff's Ctrl All, ported to elemod by Iced-Cream, with his code unchanged.
Hold TRK and turn a knob on a sound page or the TRIG page: the same step goes to that parameter on all twelve sound tracks.
Each track keeps its own offset and stops at its own limits; on the SYNTH page each track moves the knob of its own machine.
FILTER TYP sets every track to the type the selected track reaches.
With the FX track selected, a trig key held, or on the FX and global pages, the knob works as stock.
